statement: Proposed mapping from every reference IPC namespace record to a Tauri/Rust boundary. It records design intent only. Nothing here is implemented except where state is diagnostic-partial, and no entry is verified on any platform.

callerClasses.app-window: Windows created by Rust from the trusted bundle, on the local origin only
callerClasses.popup-window: Rust-created popup windows with their own minimal capability set

records.replaces: Electron main-process token broker, browser sign-in handoff and session persistence
records.design: Rust owns refresh-token storage, serialized refresh and access-token minting. Sign-in opens the system browser through a vetted URL policy and completes through the deep-link handoff. Responses carry no refresh token; getValidAccessToken returns only a short-lived access token to an app window that asked for it.
constraints: Persist in the OS keychain with the reference memory-only fallback; never in WebView storage
Endpoint origin normalization and no credential attachment to redirects or arbitrary URLs
blockedBy: Authorized cloud test endpoint is not available, so only transport and unit behavior can be tested until one is provided

records.replaces: Electron safeStorage-backed workspace BYOK key store
records.design: Rust encrypts provider credentials at rest with an OS-keychain-held key, enforces workspace isolation and ordering, and exposes metadata operations. isSupported reports real keychain availability; no stub success.
constraints: Raw secrets never travel in events and are returned only where the reference returns them
Copying Electron safeStorage ciphertext is not an interoperable migration; import needs an explicit user-driven re-entry or a documented decryption path per OS

records.design: PNG bytes arrive as a raw IPC body bounded by a documented limit and are written through the Tauri clipboard facility or a vetted OS adapter. Round-trip format fidelity is a gate.
constraints: Verify the written clipboard format per OS by reading it back with a native tool

records.design: Revisioned Rust store with atomic writes; hydrated before the frontend module graph is imported so the reference synchronous reads stay valid.
constraints: Schema validation on set; unknown keys rejected rather than silently stored

records.design: Rust owns the log directory; reveal uses the OS file-manager integration with a path the host computed, never a renderer path.
Persists the language and rebuilds native menu and tray labels from it.

records.replaces: Electron import sessions in the main process
records.design: Sessions are Rust-owned, tied to the creating window, bounded in count and bytes, and disposed with the window. Batches stream over a Tauri channel or raw IPC body with cancellation that accounts for accepted work.
constraints: Paths come only from native dialogs or Tauri drag-drop events and become opaque grants; no renderer-supplied path is trusted

records.replaces: Electron preload translation of browser File selections to native paths
records.design: Tauri has no File.path. Native selection or Tauri drag-drop events yield grants consumed by createImportSession; the frontend adapter keeps the same call shape for shared UI code.
constraints: Browser-only File objects without a grant must be imported through the existing web path, not through a native path guess

records.design: Tauri 2 has no stable find-in-page API. Candidates: WebKitGTK FindController, WebView2 find APIs where exposed, WKWebView find. A per-platform spike must show match counts and navigation before this is accepted.
records.openRisk: No cross-platform stable API; if a platform cannot match semantics the difference must be documented as a legitimate platform difference, not omitted

records.replaces: Electron popup windows for notifications and recording
records.design: Rust creates popup WebViews with their own minimal capability set; commands are granted to the popup label only.

records.replaces: Electron recording coordinator over native media_capture
records.design: Port the coordinator state machine to Rust over the existing media-capture crate without N-API. Permission flows are OS specific. Linux is unavailable as in the reference.
constraints: Real capture on Windows and macOS only; mocks do not satisfy P24

records.replaces: Electron shared global state and cache with synchronous preload reads
records.design: Rust holds revisioned state. The page is hydrated before the application imports, then updates flow through events carrying revision and source ID so echoes are suppressed and cross-view order is preserved.

records.replaces: Electron window, tab and view manager
records.design: Rust owns windows, tabs and workbench metadata. Native decorations stay hidden from construction, so the minimize, maximize and close actions below are driven by the application controls.
constraints: openExternal accepts only validated schemes and never receives native capabilities in the opened content
captureArea needs a per-OS WebView capture adapter with exact-area tests
getChallengeResponse reuses the existing hashcash implementation without N-API

records.design: Tauri updater with a signed feed for fork artifacts. Progress flows over a channel and restart-install preserves local data.
blockedBy: Signing keys and a controlled update feed are not available

records.replaces: Electron MessagePort broker for shared and background workers
records.design: Decision recorded in worker-transport-decision.md: dedicated Workers with a private port to a trusted main-thread bridge session; SharedWorker is not relied on because Linux and macOS WebViews give it an opaque origin that cannot use IndexedDB.
records.openRisk: P21 asks to share workers across tabs. Cross-tab sharing of background work must be provided by Rust-owned sessions or a documented difference; it is not yet designed

records.design: Read-only Rust reader of legacy v1 files used by the migration; backups are taken before any conversion and the originals are never modified.
constraints: Back up WAL-backed databases consistently, not by copying storage.db alone

records.replaces: No exported members at the reference revision
records.design: Nothing to implement; the record is kept so the empty registry is explicit.

records.replaces: Electron native dialogs for database files and the sync folder
records.design: Dialogs are opened by Rust through the Tauri dialog facility, return opaque grants and keep system-owned presentation.
Reuse the existing disk_sync engine without N-API. Sessions are owned by the starting window; events stream over a channel and stop with the session.
constraints: Traversal, symlink and race tests plus real file round trips

records.design: Session-scoped channel with a bounded queue and an explicit resync signal when the consumer lags.
StorageSession owns one host-granted space, with the dedicated-Worker bridge in front. The diagnostic exercises getDoc and pushUpdate only; the rest is not implemented.
constraints: Raw binary bodies with a ticket header; bounds enforced in the core independently of the bridge
Snapshot and revision event transport are not designed in code yet

records.replaces: Electron helper Mermaid and Typst rendering
records.design: Reuse affine_preview without N-API on a bounded blocking pool; input size and render time are limited and invalid input returns an explicit error.

records.replaces: Electron helper workspace enumeration, trash and backup recovery
records.design: Rust owns the sessionData layout and performs moves with backup-first semantics; identifiers are validated, never joined into paths as given.

records.replaces: No exported members at the reference revision
records.design: Nothing to implement; the record is kept so the empty registry is explicit.
Native Tauri menu items emit targeted events to the focused app window; accelerators are verified per OS.
Targeted event to the popup label only.
No stable Tauri API: needs per-OS adapters (Linux logind or UPower, Windows power broadcast, macOS IOKit) with an initial state read.
records.openRisk: Adapter choice per OS is unproven

records.replaces: Electron recording status and import queue notifications
records.design: Revisioned events, registered before the first snapshot.
Revision and source ID on every event; terminal lag forces a resnapshot.
Targeted per-window events; tab events carry revisions so reorder and close races are detected.
Channel events for availability, progress and readiness.
blockedBy: Signing keys and a controlled update feed are not available

nonIpcSurfaces.surface: Editor and blocks run in the existing shared frontend inside the native WebView
nonIpcSurfaces.evidence: Native WebView smoke on three platforms covers creation and text input only

nonIpcSurfaces.surface: Edgeless canvas in the shared frontend
nonIpcSurfaces.evidence: Native WebView smoke switches to edgeless only

nonIpcSurfaces.surface: Workspaces, documents, search and navigation in the shared frontend
Tab strip visuals and drag behavior
Tray or menu-bar item and close-to-tray
Embedded assets, custom protocol, CSP, URL policy and API proxy
nonIpcSurfaces.evidence: Enforced CSP with embedded frontend passes on three platforms

nonIpcSurfaces.surface: Installers, signing and CI architecture matrix
nonIpcSurfaces.evidence: None yet; signing credentials are not available
